sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Remove all 3 green blocks and check if level completes
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens)}")

for g in greens:
    gc = [p[1] for p in g['boundary']]
    gr = [p[0] for p in g['boundary']]
    center_r = (min(gr) + max(gr)) // 2
    center_c = (min(gc) + max(gc)) // 2
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c}])
    greens_now = len([n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N'])
    done = result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done')
    print(f"Removed green: greens={greens_now}, done={done}")
    if done:
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break

# If not done, try pressing ACTION7
if not done:
    result = action(['ACTION7'])
    done = result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done')
    print(f"ACTION7: done={done}")
    
# If still not done, try moving LEFT/RIGHT
if not done:
    for move in ['LEFT', 'RIGHT']:
        result = action([move])
        done = result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done')
        print(f"{move}: done={done}")
        if done:
            print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
            break
        if move == 'LEFT':
            # Move back RIGHT to restore state
            action(['RIGHT'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
